metric_definitions.protocol: Versioned finite diagnostic protocol; no runtime or validation improvement is presumed.
metric_definitions.replay: At most ten independently cloned cached batches; never advances a live loader.
metric_definitions.routing: Explicit host category identity checked against the model attribute when supplied.
metric_definitions.sampler_contract: Reserved MASK, real labels, B x L int64 arrays and all-MASK supervision; does not verify provenance or negative distribution.
metric_definitions.embedding_alignment: Mapped ordered off-diagonal mean cosine over up to 2048 real embeddings, seed 42. 0.5 means approximately zero cosine.
metric_definitions.mutation_suite: Ten dependent unchanged controls per fixture, then one isolated mutant and restoration control. Coverage excludes execution errors and missing evidence; Wilson interval is descriptive.

metric_definitions.residual_patching: Core serialized-serving and state-isolation prerequisites have not passed.
